kicker: Modelled in Blender · written by this add-on · drawn live
title: Asterion
text: HagopJay's orrery: champagne-gold rings, a faceted core, five specimen spheres and a field of beads, modelled and lit in Blender, then written out as X3D 4.0 by this add-on. Drag the slider. Left is Blender's Cycles path tracer. Right is the X3D file running in the browser in X_ITE, with no plugin.
note: 2 MB of X3D, three shadow-casting lights, so it takes a moment to load

kicker: Light baked in Blender, carried into X3D
title: LUMEN · interference atelier
text: Two wave sources interfering across a sculpted sheet. The height colours were baked to vertex colours in Blender and exported by this add-on as X3D 4.0: 36,864 colours, straight into the browser.
facts: 36,864 baked colours · ColorRGBA in the X3D

title: Still life
text: The add-on's test piece: built in Blender, written as X3D 4.0 PhysicalMaterial with a marble texture, then measured against the Cycles render it came from.

title: PRISMATICA · Aurora Cathedral
text: Aurora curtains from HagopJay's Unreal project, converted to X3D by his own Python converter. This add-on imports that X3D into Blender and Blender's glTF exporter writes the glb, so one cathedral runs as X3D in X_ITE and as glTF in Babylon.js. Slide between them.
